B2M.insertion_safety_scope: SNV AVI scores evaluate point-mutation regulatory sensitivity only; kilobase knock-in at chr15:44711608|44711609 disrupts endogenous B2M Exon 1 (62 nt downstream of native ATG at 44711547). Because B2M_HA_L retains the native 5'-UTR and ATG (44711547), any sense read-through transcript initiating at the endogenous B2M promoter carries a 60-aa uORF in Arm 1A (construct pos 739..921, peptide MSRSVALAVLALLSLSGLEAMLRCPSVGRAHIAHSPREVGGRGRQLNRCLEKVARGKLGK*, with 2 internal sense ATGs inside the uORF and 0 after the stop codon before the HLA-E SCT Kozak ATG at 1173) or a 21-aa uORF in Arm 1B (construct pos 539..604, peptide MSRSVALAVLALLSLSGLEAI*, followed by 11 intervening sense ATGs [10 across the antisense CD47-EEF1A1 cassette at 613..1457 plus 1 at 1574..1576 inside Syn_5xISRE_minP_148bp_sense upstream of the internal TSS at 1596] before the HLA-E SCT Kozak ATG at 1647). IMPORTANT STRAND ORIENTATION NOTE: In Arm 1B, SV40_late_polyA_122bp_antisense (parts[1], 601..722, orientation '-') is oriented on the antisense (-) strand to terminate the convergent antisense CD47 transcript and does NOT terminate sense-strand (+) transcription from the endogenous B2M promoter. Consequently, endogenous B2M promoter read-through is NOT credited for productive HLA-E translation; sense HLA-E transcription in Arm 1B initiates exclusively from the internal sense promoter Syn_5xISRE_minP_148bp_sense (and from EEF1A1_core_promoter_230bp in Arm 1A), whose 5' leaders contain zero upstream ATGs before the HLA-E Kozak start (closes AUDIT-REF, 022, & AUDIT-REF).
